_about: Runtime settings, created next to the app on first run. my_name: your pilot name as shown in game. monitor: 1 = primary. fps: lance-panel reads per second. full_every: seconds between full-frame reads. panel_region / target_region: the lance panel and the target info panel as fractions of the game window. ocr_dml: use the GPU (DirectML) instead of the CPU. ocr_threads: CPU threads for OCR. donate_url: the support link shown in the app. capture: "window" reads the game window's own surface (other windows on top are excluded; exclusive fullscreen falls back to the screen), "screen" always reads the screen region. stats_since: set by RESET on a MY MECHS card, mech -> the moment that mech's stats count from (earlier records are kept but not counted); UNDO on the card removes the entry.
